stories.headline: GTA 6 is 4 days away.
stories.body: Rockstar's game launches <mark>November 19</mark> in a <mark>rolling midnight launch</mark>, starting in New Zealand and moving across time zones. On PS5, <mark>pre-loading has been open since November 10</mark>, so you can have it downloaded before it unlocks.

stories.headline: Apple's $299 screen talks back.
stories.body: Apple's <mark>HomeView</mark> smart display went on sale <mark>November 13</mark> for <mark>$299</mark> in the US. It has a <mark>7-inch screen</mark>, <mark>Siri AI</mark>, face recognition for <mark>up to six users</mark>, and does FaceTime, music and an intercom to other Apple devices.

stories.headline: Microsoft was down for 24+ hours.
stories.body: A <mark>global outage</mark> hit <mark>Teams, Outlook and Copilot</mark> and disrupted businesses and governments for <mark>over 24 hours</mark>. Microsoft says the <mark>underlying issue is now fixed</mark> and services have <mark>fully recovered</mark>.

stories.headline: Most anti-aging supplements didn't help.
stories.body: Yale researchers reviewed <mark>51 clinical studies</mark>. <mark>Exercise plus a healthy diet</mark> and some drugs like <mark>metformin and semaglutide</mark> lowered biological age markers. Over-the-counter <mark>supplements generally didn't</mark>. Catch: nobody has shown it means <mark>living longer</mark>.
